name: TREX-DM
full_name: TPC for Rare Event eXperiments – Dark Matter
summary: TREX-DM uses a high-pressure gas TPC with micropattern readout at Canfranc to search for low-mass WIMPs, emphasizing ultralow thresholds and radioactive-background control.
detection_principle: Nuclear recoils ionize a light-gas target. After drift, signals are read by Micromegas and, in later configurations, a GEM preamplification system, reconstructing energy and event topology.

key_parameters.name: Targeted mass range
key_parameters.value: WIMPs below approximately 10 GeV; the specific threshold depends on configuration.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
